chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Never practicing; Coleman Hawkins
summary: Neither he nor Hawkins practiced, only playing on the job for half an hour.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: You mentioned Coleman Hawkins was in that band with you and Fletcher and Charles Holiday.
Clarence Holiday. Could you just fill us in on what kind of things did the musicians, each of them - did you ever hear Coleman Hawkins practicing during those times that you were with -
I never heard him practice in my life.
You never played your instrument in the daytime?
Very seldom, just pick it up -
Get on the job and play about a half hour - because we knew the tunes of some of the music we had to read. We had the music all the time.
But I mean, did you feel content, did you feel that you were improving on your instrument?
I was very content with everybody.
